svg.title: Crown
svg.desc: Same file as in 06-bible-sections/. Book group “History” (share.js `ICONS.history`: picker, shelf, web); menu “Kings” (the kings of Israel and Judah); emoji mark “King”; the timeline’s default icon for dynasties, kingdoms and reigns. Colors: #bf5a1f (light mode) / #f59a62 (dark mode) · Timeline “crown”: items named crowned, coronat; items named dynasty, empire, kingdom, tsardom, duchy, raj, rule, komnenos, palaiologos, kingdoms; From Creation: “The kingdom divides”; default for reigns and unmatched items; kings and queens among Lives in the Bible (Drawn at stroke-width 1.8, 1.9, 2 in different places.)
